allytips: target marked by Valor will put Harrier on cooldown. Quickly consuming Harrier marks will allow you to generate them faster.
Vault is powerful but must be used with caution, as enemies can attack Quinn when she strikes them. Vault can sometimes be used to cross terrain if your back is to a wall.
Use Behind Enemy Lines for traveling very long distances quickly, for farming minions around the map, or for chasing wounded targets.
Quinn.blurb: Quinn is an elite ranger-knight of Demacia, who undertakes dangerous missions deep in enemy territory. She and her legendary eagle, Valor, share an unbreakable bond, and their foes are often slain before they realize they are fighting not one, but two...
enemytips: After being marked, move away from Quinn so she can't take advantage of it.
Keep tabs on Quinn's position. Behind Enemy Lines can enable Valor to cross the map very quickly and attack you by surprise.
When Quinn is using Behind Enemy Lines, damaging her removes her Move Speed bonus temporarily.
Quinn.lore: Quinn is an elite ranger-knight of Demacia, who undertakes dangerous missions deep in enemy territory. She and her legendary eagle, Valor, share an unbreakable bond, and their foes are often slain before they realize they are fighting not one, but two of the kingdom's greatest heroes. Nimble and acrobatic when required, Quinn takes aim with her crossbow while Valor marks their elusive targets from above, making them a deadly pair on the battlefield.
Quinn.name: Quinn

passive.description: Valor, Quinn's Demacian eagle, periodically marks enemies with <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor>. Quinn's first basic attack against <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor> targets will deal bonus physical damage.
passive.name: Harrier

spells.description: Quinn calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision before damaging all enemies in the immediate area.
spells.name: Blinding Assault
spells.tooltip:
Quinn orders Valor to dive, making the first enemy hit with Harrier, reducing their vision radius for {{ visionreductionduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage to all surrounding enemies.

If the first enemy struck is not a champion, it is Disarmed for {{ visionreductionduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor> target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.
spells.name: Heightened Senses
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Attacking a Harrier target grants Quinn {{ attackspeedbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed and {{ movespeedamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ buffduration }} seconds.

Active: Valor reveals a large area nearby for {{ visionduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.
spells.name: Vault
spells.tooltip: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} physical damage</physicalDamage> and marking them with <keywordMajor>Harrier</keywordMajor>. Quinn then leaps backwards from the target, slightly <status>Knocking</status> them <status>Back</status> and <status>Slowing</status> them by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowdecaytime }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.description: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed.  Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions with Harrier.
spells.name: Behind Enemy Lines
spells.tooltip:
Quinn calls to Valor, pairing up after channeling for 2 seconds gaining {{ movementspeedmod*100 }}% Move Speed and allowing her to Recast this Ability. Attacking or using Blinding Assault or Vault automatically Recasts this Ability.

Recast: Quinn and Valor perform an aerial maneuver, dealing {{ damage }} physical damage, marking champions with Harrier, and ending this Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

Quinn.title: Demacia's Wings
